title: VESPER SemanticScene
description: IC-005. The artifact on which the entire 'VESPER is not a chat UI' claim rests. COC ARCH-20 requires output represented as a semantic scene 'rather than a device-specific screen dump'. THERE IS NO FREE-FORM MARKDOWN OR HTML FIELD ANYWHERE IN THIS SCHEMA (INV-SCENE-3, enforced by CI-028) -- such a field is a hole through which the whole contract drains, because every producer would use it and no spatial or voice renderer could consume it. Authority: DR-004, DR-010, DR-021, RB-007, RB-022, ARCH-06, ARCH-20, ARCH-28, SR-046; REM-009.

privacy_class.description: Input to DF-SELECT-ENDPOINT. INV-PRIV-1: an unknown person in the target space, or low location confidence, routes to the most private surface or WITHHOLDS -- never to the most public.

update_mode.description: 'stream' is ARCHITECTURAL, not an optimisation: REM-010's latency budget requires first audio to begin before generation completes, which a deliver-complete-only scene makes unmeetable by construction.

type.description: Every type declares a degradation ladder per endpoint capability class (CI-030). The 'diagram' voice-only rung is a STRUCTURAL NARRATION -- which is only derivable because content is typed rather than pre-rendered.

content.description: Typed per element type. 'text' carries a plain string plus presentation_intent -- it does NOT carry markup. A rendered image cannot be narrated; a typed graph can.

presentation_intent.description: INTENT, NEVER STYLING. No fonts, colours, sizes or coordinates appear here or anywhere in this schema; a scene carrying them would be a screen layout in disguise.

spatial_intent.description: RELATIONAL, resolved at render time against the world-model space graph. INV-SCENE-4: no producer names an endpoint (CI-029).

space_ref.description: Required when anchor = space_anchored. A topological Space id, never metric coordinates (INV-WORLD-2).

affordances.description: DECLARED CAPABILITIES, not event handlers. 'this entity can be opened', not 'onClick'. A scene carrying handlers would be a serialised DOM.

evidence_refs.description: Links rendered claims back to REM-010 evidence, so a post-hoc correction can supersede a specific element rather than the whole scene.

renderResult.description: The renderer contract's return value. 'degradations' is REQUIRED even when empty -- an absent array is indistinguishable from an unreported drop (INV-SCENE-2).

withheld_reason.description: Set when DF-SELECT-ENDPOINT returns WITHHOLD (privacy fail-safe). Withholding is reported, never silent.
